en-US.longDescription: Altova XMLSpy is the world's best selling JSON and XML editor for modeling, editing, transforming, and debugging related technologies. XMLSpy JSON and XML Editor gives developers the tools they need to build the most sophisticated applications with its graphical schema designer, code generation, file converters, debuggers, and profilers for working with XSD, XSLT, XQuery, XBRL, SOAP, and more.
en-US.name: Altova XMLSpy 2024 Professional Edition

zh-CN.description: JSON 和 XML 编辑器
